notes.title: Chunky Explosions Update
notes.content:
Machine Gun Train Run version 1.0.8 is out.  Here's what's new:

• Added big chunky particle effects to everything that explodes - all the enemies, bullet impacts for each type of gun, rockets blowing up, missiles, and blood splatters.  Added them to the menu explosions too because why not.

• Added a boss health bar that pops up on the bottom of the screen when you encounter each level's final boss.  

• Adjusted boss arcing missile sprites so they actually point in the direction they are flying instead of flopping out like a thrown sausage.

• Fixed a couple small text errors/issues.

notes.title: Update 1.0.6 Released
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
 [*] Fixed an issue where one of the power up boxes in 2P mode was indestructable.  Now it isn't.
 [*] Improved compatibility with integrated graphics cards.

Changes:
 [*] Reflect ammo does more damage.
 [*] Energy bomb ammo does more damage.

notes.title: Update 1.0.5 Released
notes.content:
Changes in version 1.0.5:
 [*]Power-ups have been added.  Each character has 3 unique ammo types that drop throughout the levels and in Endurance Mode.
 [*]Fixed a bug in Level 1 that used to let players beat the first mini boss before starting the boss fight, leaving them unable to proceed.
 [*]Updated Level 4 music.
 [*]Added new weapon sound effects.
